content.title: Lord Jesus Christ: Devotion to Jesus in Earliest Christianity
content.author: Larry W. Hurtado (Grand Rapids: Eerdmans, 2003)
content.note: Argues that Jesus was worshipped alongside God within the first two decades, among Jewish monotheists, shown in prayer, hymns, baptism in his name and the Lord's Supper.
